The '''Rebellion Blaze''' was a quadrant of the [[Karthakk system]] that was used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] as their base of operations in the system at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

It was named after the ''[[Rebellion Blaze]]'', an infamous gunboat of the Rebel Alliance.
